lead: Anne Hathaway is an American actor, born on 12 November 1982 in Brooklyn.
As of 2026, she is 43 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.

She is associated with work such as The Princess Diaries, The Devil Wears Prada and The Dark Knight Rises and has been recognised with Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress and Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Voice-Over Performance.
This profile collects the Anne facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Anne Hathaway — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Anne Hathaway was born on 12 November 1982 in Brooklyn, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Anne Jacqueline Hathaway at birth and is publicly known as Anne Hathaway.
Public records name her father, Gerald T. Hathaway and her mother, Kate McCauley Hathaway.
She received her education at New York University, Vassar College, American Academy of Dramatic Arts and Millburn High School.
She is recorded as speaking English.
